body.message:
As requested we have 01 bedroom apartment available in Ajman and the rate is

01 bedroom Seaview - AED 17,000
01 bedroom community view - AED 15,000

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is required. The booking will be on a monthly basis only (30 nights each month).

The rate quoted above is all-inclusive and covers Wi-Fi, electricity, water, VAT, and other applicable service charges.
